verdict.rationale: Coinbase publishes an official open-source CDP SDK (coinbase/cdp-sdk) for EVM and Solana wallets, with keys secured by CDP. The docs show the same SDK powering x402 pay and charge flows, treasury USDC acceptance and payouts, and USDC subscriptions with spend permissions. missing for 10: supported languages and per-language SDK reference documentation, explicit SDK coverage of custodial payment-acceptance and checkout APIs beyond brief llms.txt mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
